_note: The single source of truth for the RL run. launch_rl.py refuses to start without it; rl_plan.py checks it. init_from and the reference cache are the ONLY items that must wait for SFT.
init_from_note: FILL AT TRANSITION: the SFT best checkpoint path. launch_rl.py verifies weights exist and hashes the dir.

data.eval_note: The forward wall is the RL eval set and is NEVER trained on. The dataset builder refuses to emit a wall episode.

loop.kl_note: KL is over the 3-action distribution (BUY/WATCH/SKIP) against a cached reference distribution. Token-level KL is NOT computable at rollout time because the cached reference logprobs belong to the SFT completion, not the sampled one.

optim.lr_note: RL LR << SFT LR (2e-6): the policy is already good.
optim.optim_note: 8-bit AdamW is the proven path on this box; full fp32 state does not fit. train_qwen27b.py asserts no fp32 master set - keep that assert.

gate.gate_note: CHECKPOINT SELECTION ONLY. Never select on training reward. The lower 95% bound of net return per episode on the wall must exceed the floor.

checkpoint.resume_note: Resume, never restart: the loop reloads optimizer+step from the newest checkpoint and skips completed prompts by prompt_sha256.

cost_calibration.note: The SFT prompts state a 210 bp round-trip cost. The V3 engine charges the RESERVE-PRICED cost, which differs. Record the measured median here before drawing conclusions across SFT and RL behaviour.
